title: Separate backup upload, task progress, manifest, import, and export service boundaries
description: AstrBot backup routes combine chunked upload sessions, background task progress, JWT-gated downloads, manifest inspection, import/export orchestration, version compatibility, database restore, KB restore, and directory restore. Rust should split backup job services from web route handlers and persistence repositories.

files.change: Define manifest, version compatibility, import/export jobs, upload sessions, progress snapshots, and backup file inventory.
Keep HTTP handlers as DTO/auth adapters over the backup job service.

criteria: Chunked upload state and cleanup are tested outside HTTP handlers.
Import/export orchestration depends on repository ports instead of concrete DB modules.
Routes expose task progress snapshots without owning background job maps.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
